question: Will the city approve my variance?

> The hearing body may approve a variance only if it makes the following findings:
> 1. > 2. The project is compatible with the immediately surrounding neighborhood and the public welfare; and

In this subsection 3, unreasonable hardship refers to the unusual physical characteristics of the property and existing improvements, and not to conditions personal to the applicant.

All three findings are required. The hardship must come from the physical features of the lot and existing buildings. Personal circumstances don't count.

Your statement of reasons is where you would address the three findings.
